items.title: SD-018 AMEND validation: does supervising z_world on the DIRECTIONAL resource field lift a z_world-only reader's foraging competence? (+ fishtank observable)
items.note: OWED POST-IMPLEMENTATION VALIDATION of the SD-018 AMEND (directional resource-field head on z_world), landed ree-v3 028a625 2026-09-02, whose own commit message records 'Validation experiment NOT queued'. Routing chip chip-20260902-sd018-fieldhead-validation-run. EVIDENCE (not diagnostic): INV-088 primary, MECH-457 read-across only. | DESIGN: 2 arms + 2 anchors. field_loss_off / field_loss_on both BUILD the directional head and run the identical x734 all-ON stack; the ONLY difference is the P0a loss weight (zworld_p0_resource_field_weight 0.0 vs 0.5). Both arms' PPO readers see z_world ALONE (32 dims) -- the side-channel V3-EXQ-948 used is REMOVED, which is what this run contributes that 948 could not: 948 proved the field CONTENT is sufficient for competence by concatenating it onto the reader's input; it said nothing about whether that content can be carried THROUGH z_world. Env kwargs, rung (D3_hazard_free), weighting (W3_survival_zeroed), seeds, PPO hyperparameters, eval protocol and P0/P1 budgets are imported from x734/x808 rather than redefined. Both arms get their OWN warmup -- forced, because here the manipulation IS the encoder's training objective, so a shared warmup would erase it. | SEAM PREREQUISITE: the head was UNTRAINABLE from any driver in this family until 2026-09-02 (ZWorldP0Config.resource_field_weight defaults 0.0; run_zworld_p0 passed no override; _train_all_on_agent calls neither field loss). Seam LANDED ree-v3 65c37c8 (origin/main), pinned by contract C6 in tests/contracts/test_sd018_resource_field_head.py. chip-20260902-sd018-p0a-field-weight-seam. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): no manifest under evidence/experiments/ carries resource_field_weight or used_resource_field_head -- the substrate did not exist until today, so nothing is recoverable by reanalysis. Run required. | red-team (fable): 8 findings, ALL APPLIED before queueing, none waived. F1 (confirmed by independent measurement) -- constructing resource_field_head consumes torch RNG draws and SplitEncoder builds it BEFORE world_topdown/self_topdown, so an arm pair differing in whether the head EXISTS also differs in the random init of modules that are never trained (world_path_parameters() = world_encoder + world_precision_logit only) yet feed sense()-time z_world directly: an arm-correlated untrained random term in the exact quantity the reader consumes. Fixed by building the head in BOTH arms. F8 -- p1 was passing P1_REINFORCE+P1_PPO (1090) where the family passes P1_REINFORCE (90), a 12x budget drift; fixed. F2/F5(doc) -- the manipulation is a REWEIGHTING not presence-vs-absence (reconstruction_weight 10.0 already reconstructs the full 250-wide world_obs INCLUDING the field at [225:250], so the OFF arm is supervised on it at 10/250 per element and the ON arm adds 0.5/25, a ~1.5x reweighting); the OFF arm's ABSOLUTE decode r2 is therefore as informative as the lift. F3 -- an uninformative branch was reporting dir_inv088='weakens'; the two null branches (P0a never moved z_world's field content; decode unmeasurable) are statements about THIS recipe and instrumentation, not about the hypothesis, and now report 'unknown', with a distinct label decode_unmeasurable_direction_unattributable separating an unmeasurable decode from a measured flat one. Extended to the partial-non-vacuity case: a RED ON arm emits no claim direction at all. F4 -- C_decode_lift required only the 0.05 margin, satisfiable between two sub-mean decodes (r2 -0.90 -> -0.85 is a lift of nothing); now also requires r_on > 0 absolutely. F5(code) -- new ON-arm precondition field_head_decodes_on_arm on P0a's OWN held-out field r2 > 0, so a head that RAN but LEARNED NOTHING reads as a failed operating point rather than as a scientific null about SD-018 (field_leg_ran is only a CONFIGURATION predicate). F6 -- encoder-path participation ratio and decode reported alongside the sense-time ones. F7 -- the fishtank trace logs the head's argmax on BOTH the sense-time z_world the policy consumes AND the encoder-path z_world P0a actually trains; sense-time z is (world_encoder(w) + world_topdown(...)) * prec while P0a trains world_encoder(w) * prec alone, so a head that tracks the gradient on the encoder path but not at sense time localises the failure to the top-down term -- the observation that would route a null to shape (b) rather than back to the P0a recipe. | FISHTANK: the user asked to be able to WATCH this. A separate, additional log pass (NOT the scored data -- the DV comes from evaluate_seed on its own fresh env) writes <run_id>_episode_log.json in the schema REE_assembly/fishtank_viz.html renders, carrying per step resource_field_true_argmax, resource_field_pred_argmax and resource_field_pred_argmax_encoder_path on BOTH arms, so the OFF arm is the untrained within-run chance baseline rather than a null column. | PRE-REGISTERED NULL: if ON does not clear the 1.0 D3 floor and the decode did not lift, shape (b) (routing the raw field past z_world as a side-channel) is the next build -- a real pre-registered outcome, not a failure of this run. | Smoke PASS (--dry-run 2026-09-02): both arms constructed, P0a field leg confirmed ACTUALLY RAN on the ON arm only (used_resource_field_head True w=0.5 vs False w=0.0), encoder-path PR 3.74 vs sense-time 5.07 confirming the two paths genuinely differ, F5c precondition correctly marked the ON arm red under a 2-episode budget WITHOUT vacating the OFF arm, and per-claim direction correctly read 'unknown' rather than weakening INV-088. validate_experiments.py --strict OK on all 30 checks. Contract gate: 5525 passed full six-root suite (hub) plus 819 passed on the corpus-lint + SD-018 subset. | episodes_per_run 1350 = 60 P0a + 200 P0 + 90 P1-REINFORCE + 1000 P1-PPO per TRAINING cell; the 2 anchor conditions train nothing. | FISHTANK VIEWER: REE_assembly 4c14694f13 adds the SD-018 overlay that draws the true gradient peak and both predicted peaks on the tank, with a majority-cell baseline (NOT uniform 1/25) because an untrained constant-argmax head reads 95% against uniform chance. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): FIRES on both claims (INV-088 4 counted autopsies, MECH-457 11) and is ADJUDICATED EXEMPT under the documented 'redesign of a different mechanism' clause -- stated explicitly rather than ignored. Those autopsies established a ceiling against the PRE-AMEND substrate; this run is the first test of the SD-018 directional resource-field head, which did not exist before ree-v3 028a625 (2026-09-02) and could not receive a single gradient step from any driver in this family until the P0a seam landed (65c37c8, same day). It is therefore not a same-granularity lettered re-test that re-derives a known ceiling -- the substrate under it changed. Both claims independently carry pending_retest_after_substrate: True, i.e. they are flagged as AWAITING exactly this re-test once the blocking substrate lands, and it has. Two notes on the brake text itself, recorded so a later reader does not have to re-derive them: (a) it names 'SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training' as INV-088's blocking upstream, taken from the latest counted autopsy (V3-EXQ-954, 2026-08-29) -- a DIFFERENT mechanism from the one this run tests; (b) it reports that substrate as not IMPLEMENTED, but ree-v3/CLAUDE.md line 18943 records SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 2 as IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-01 (validated by V3-EXQ-976), so the brake appears to be matching an older ITEM's status under the same substrate name.

items.title: ContextMemory write-content discrimination portfolio, leg H1 (loss-objective-mismatch): does a content-referencing contrastive loss achieve content-conditioned write addressing?
items.note: Leg H1 (loss-objective-mismatch) of the frozen contextmemory_write_content_discrimination portfolio (H1-H4, chip-20260830-ctxmem-write-content-h1h4-portfolio). H1's null: the existing pairwise-diversity write-addressing loss references no content label; swapping in a content-referencing (contrastive) objective at the same schedule does not drop Jaccard by the 0.25 margin in EITHER of two regimes. DUAL REGIME (avoids conflation with sibling H4, V3-EXQ-972): Regime A (real agent, env-driven safe/dangerous context, held-out real-latent probe, 100ep x 150 steps) and Regime B (synthetic 2-cluster stream, direct 15000-step SGD on the tagger alone, matching V3-EXQ-907's own real schedule). LOAD-BEARING: PASS iff EITHER regime's own readiness gate is green AND its Jaccard drops by >=0.25 with a Bonferroni-corrected (alpha=0.025 across 2 regimes) paired sign-flip permutation p-value -- OR-combination is deliberate (either regime succeeding is evidence FOR H1; the null requires BOTH to fail). GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): the decisive readout (Jaccard for a content-REFERENCING objective) is not recorded anywhere -- 956 trained under a different, content-BLIND loss and was minted without include_driver_script_in_hash=False regardless; not recoverable, proceeding fresh. Step 2.5c (re-checked 2026-09-01): same disposition as 969/972 -- only the entry under test (contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy) overlaps; mode-governance-engagement/SD-082 removed by construction. Step 2.5b: N/A, claim_ids=[]. red-team (fable), 2026-09-02: BLOCKING -> FIXED, then re-verified CLEAR for the fix. Original finding: the load-bearing exact sign-flip permutation test's minimum ATTAINABLE one-sided p-value at n=5 seeds is 1/2**5=0.03125, exceeding ALPHA_CORRECTED=0.025 -- the PASS branch was unreachable under EVERY possible outcome, including a perfect same-direction result on all 5 seeds, in BOTH regimes (they share SEEDS). FIXED by extending SEEDS from 5 to 6 seeds ([42,7,13,100,200,300]): 1/2**6=0.015625 < 0.025 restores attainability. Independent re-verification pass (fable, same day) confirmed CLEAR: all 6 seeds genuinely flow through both regimes' load-bearing computation (no stale 5-length slice or hardcoded list found), the arithmetic holds against the script's own current ALPHA_CORRECTED, and the added seed is a linear compute-cost increase only, no correctness issue. An earlier design pass (documented in-file as Findings F1-F4, 2026-09-01) had already fixed: F1 (Regime B's probe tested generalization to unseen clusters, not training success), F2 (Regime A's probe was on unrelated synthetic clusters rather than genuinely held-out real latents), F3 (a 158x training-update-budget asymmetry between regimes, reduced to ~10x), F4 (a bare mean-margin test's ~15% false-positive rate under the null, replaced with the Bonferroni-corrected permutation test that F5/this pass then found unreachable at n=5 and fixed by raising n to 6). Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2026-09-02, re-verified after fix): Regime A cells FAIL at toy scale (expected -- 2 episodes cannot build a real state buffer), Regime B cells PASS; ep N/M and verdict lines present; z_goal_stream unmeasured. COST: Regime A 12 cells x 100ep x 150 steps + Regime B 12 cells (6 trained @ 15000 SGD steps on a small MLP, 6 untrained/eval-only); estimated_minutes is a rough extrapolation from the 956/943 lineage's own recorded range, approximate.

items.title: ContextMemory write-content discrimination portfolio, leg H3 (task-pressure-required): does routing the read-path's task gradient through write selection achieve content conditioning?
items.note: Leg H3 (task-pressure-required) of the frozen contextmemory_write_content_discrimination portfolio (H1-H4, chip-20260830-ctxmem-write-content-h1h4-portfolio). H3's null: no standalone write-side auxiliary loss suffices (956's content-blind pairwise-diversity loss and sibling H1's content-referencing standalone loss are both members of this family); coupled training via the READ path's own task gradient still fails the 0.25 Jaccard margin. MECHANISM: a straight-through soft-read (softmax over write_addr_tagger's scores @ frozen memory content) feeds agent.e3.harm_eval_head via a newly-constructed bridging linear layer (read_bridge, memory_dim=128 -> world_dim=32; no existing substrate component has that exact shape), producing a real harm-prediction loss against the environment's own harm label. Two arms: H3_UNTRAINED (loss computed for logging only via a detached forward pass, weight=0.0, structurally never added to the backward graph) vs H3_TRAINED (weight=1.0, genuinely added to total before optimizer.step()). Optimizer group excludes harm_eval_head's own parameters (a separate harm_eval_opt zero_grads its stale gradient before its own unrelated step). LOAD-BEARING: PASS iff the untrained-baseline readiness precondition (>=0.25) holds AND mean_jaccard(TRAINED) <= mean_jaccard(UNTRAINED) - 0.25. GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): the decisive readout (task-COUPLED gumbel_learned Jaccard) is not recorded anywhere; not recoverable, proceeding fresh. Step 2.5c (re-checked 2026-09-01): same disposition as 969/970/972. Step 2.5b: N/A, claim_ids=[]. red-team (fable), 2026-09-02: CONTESTED -> 3 findings. G1 (manipulation could not reach the DV at full strength) -- FIXED: agent.e3.harm_eval_head already ends in its own nn.Sigmoid() (harm in [0,1], per e3_selector.py), so feeding its output through F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits (both in this driver's own h3_loss AND in the pre-existing harm_eval_opt loop inherited from V3-EXQ-956) was a double sigmoid: the effective probability is confined to sigmoid((0,1))=(0.5,0.731) with no attainable stationary point, so the loss perpetually saturates and its gradient into read_bridge/soft_probs/write_addr_tagger collapses. Harmless scaffolding in 956; load-bearing here, since it is H3's own gradient-transmission line. Fixed at both call sites to plain F.binary_cross_entropy on the head's already-probabilistic output. G2 (verdict grid over-claims on FAIL) -- DISMISSED with a disclosed caveat: a FAIL does not distinguish 'H3 is false' from 'read_bridge (a full trainable layer in the same optimizer group) found a shortcut that reduces h3_loss without meaningfully engaging the tagger' or 'frozen memory content carries no harm-relevant information to route regardless of H3's truth'; NOT fixed here (isolating this needs a third, detached-scores control arm -- a bigger design change than this pass's remit). Only the FAIL direction is affected: a PASS remains fully attributable to H3, since read_bridge alone has no mechanism to move a downstream synthetic-probe Jaccard it never touches. G3 (gate certifies its own subject, noted, non-blocking): the mechanical positive control's threshold (TAGGER_MOVE_EPS=1e-8) is loose relative to Adam's own step size and certifies graph connectivity rather than usable signal -- true but non-gating/descriptive only; the paired negative control (Gumbel noise cannot move params, sampling lives inside write()'s own no_grad block) is sound. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2026-09-02, re-verified after fix): both arms printed verdict lines, ep N/M present, z_goal_stream unmeasured. COST: 10 cells x 100 episodes x 150 steps; estimated_minutes approximate, extrapolated from the 956/943 lineage's own recorded range.

items.title: ContextMemory write-content discrimination portfolio, leg H4 (input-distribution): is the real train-time write-stream representation separable by context at all?
items.note: Leg H4 (input-distribution) of the frozen contextmemory_write_content_discrimination portfolio (H1-H4, chip-20260830-ctxmem-write-content-h1h4-portfolio). H4's null (this leg's own falsifier, verbatim from the frozen registry): 'latents carry separable structure the tagger ignores' -- i.e. if the actual write-stream states already show clear inter-context separation via a simple representation-only statistic, that REFUTES H4 and refocuses blame on H1/H3 (the addressing ALGORITHM, not the input it receives). MEASUREMENT-ONLY diagnostic, single arm (GUMBEL_TRAINED, identical training config to V3-EXQ-956's own trained arm -- this leg does not test whether addressing training succeeds, it instruments the INPUT that training receives regardless of outcome): instruments the real write-stream state tensor at every step, bucketed by safe/dangerous context, records intra_safe_cosine / intra_dangerous_cosine / inter_cosine / separability_score = mean(intra) - inter. LOAD-BEARING criterion (H4_representation_separability_measured) is a MEASUREMENT-VALIDITY gate only (passes iff >=3/5 seeds had enough buffered samples, >=50 per bucket, regardless of the sign of separability_score) -- the actual scientific reading (interpretation.h4_reading: 'representation_separable' if mean separability_score > 0.05, else 'representation_undifferentiated') is explicitly non-gating and descriptive. GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): 956 never recorded per-step write-stream state tensors (only deterministic occupancy DVs and the post-training synthetic-probe Jaccard), and was minted without include_driver_script_in_hash=False regardless; not recoverable, proceeding fresh. Step 2.5c (re-checked 2026-09-01): same disposition as 969/970/971 -- contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy IS the entry this leg's write-stream is drawn from; mode-governance-engagement/SD-082/SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training all removed by construction (this driver never enables their gating flags or code paths). Step 2.5b: N/A, claim_ids=[]. red-team (fable), 2026-09-02: CONTESTED -> 1 finding, DISMISSED with a disclosed caveat rather than fixed. separability_score has no null control for temporal/episode autocorrelation: intra-bucket pairs include same-episode and same-5-episode-block pairs while inter-bucket pairs are always cross-block and time-separated, so slow representation drift over 100 episodes could produce intra>inter with zero content-CONDITIONED structure; only scalar stats reach the manifest (no per-state episode/step index), so no permutation/shuffle null can be computed post-hoc if this is ever suspected. NOT fixed here (the concrete fix -- store (episode_idx, step_idx) per buffered state, add a block-shuffle permutation control -- is a real but non-trivial instrumentation addition, out of this pass's scope). Mitigating factors recorded in the script docstring: the load-bearing criterion already gates only on sample-sufficiency, not on the sign of separability_score; intra_safe/intra_dangerous cosines are reported separately so a reader can see a uniformly-tight cone (autocorrelation-consistent); and the non-gating cross-reference against 956's own synthetic-probe Jaccard (not subject to this confound) gives an independent check -- persistent disagreement between the two readings would flag a governance reviewer to demand the permutation-null treatment before trusting a 'representation_separable' reading at face value. Smoke test at toy scale correctly self-routes to a readiness FAIL (2 episodes cannot reach the 50-sample-per-bucket floor) -- expected, not a bug; verdict line and ep N/M present, z_goal_stream unmeasured. COST: 5 cells x 100 episodes x 150 steps (single arm); estimated_minutes approximate, extrapolated from the 956/943 lineage's own recorded range.

items.title: H-c readout-regime sibling probe: does the hybrid E1/E2 Phase-4 evaluator suppress depth damping visible in E1's own rollout map? (sibling to 976/ITEM-3, never a gate)
items.note: H-c fan-out sibling probe from the confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-976_2026-09-02 (user-confirmed 2026-09-02, Q2 = yes, run alongside; SIBLING, never a gate on the ITEM-3 rollout-endpoint contrastive build H-f). QUESTION: 976 measured DEPTH DAMPING (ON arms grow less than OFF in cr_ratio(h) from h=1 to h>=2, 8/8 ON cells) under the Phase-4 HYBRID E1/E2 evaluator only (re-primes z_self from E2, re-projects E1 prior/context per step from h=2). The map rollout_consistency_loss actually trains is E1's OWN autoregressive predict_long_horizon (prior/context once, own predicted total fed back) -- the two coincide exactly at h=1 and diverge from h=2, so whether the damping is a property of E1's trained weights or an artifact of the hybrid consumer's regime (the SAME scorer as the MECH-135 30-step endpoint, 108b:451-463) was unmeasured. DESIGN: RETRAIN of 976's exact shape (976's agents were never saved) -- byte-identical Phases 0a/0b/1/2/3 (same 4 arms, 4 seeds [42,123,7,2024], readiness gates, B1 depth-0 symmetrisation, non-routing stateful anchor); adds a SECOND Phase-4 readout (E1DeepPredictor.predict_long_horizon on the same 40 candidate sequences at the same checkpoints) BESIDE the existing hybrid readout. Diagnostic, claim_ids=[] deliberate (non_contributory by design; bears on MECH-135/INV-088 read-across only, retests neither). DECLARED NULL (both directions): readout_regime_consistent_damping_replicates (both readouts agree the ON arms damp relative to OFF -- 976's finding is a property of E1's weights) vs readout_regime_discrepant_consumer_suppresses_divergence (hybrid damped, e1-alone NOT -- the consumer's regime suppresses a real effect, so any MECH-135 endpoint successor must use an E1-alone readout). action_cond_unzero_self_slot=True on every arm (unchanged open decision, no new evidence either way). New EXQ number per the autopsy (different scientific question -- readout regime, not objective -- though the manipulation is identical to 976). GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): decisive readout (E1-alone predict_long_horizon at h>1) has never been computed in this lineage (954/965/968/976 all use the hybrid scorer only); no manifest under evidence/experiments/ carries it -- not recoverable, run required. Substrate readiness (2.5): SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 2 IMPLEMENTED+VALIDATED 2026-09-01 (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; validated by V3-EXQ-976) -- this run is diagnostic read-across on the same landed substrate, not a new dependency. Re-derive brake (2.5b): N/A, claim_ids=[]. Substrate-path overlap (2.5c): exercises e1_deep.py::predict_long_horizon and ContextMemory.write identically to 976 (see that driver's identical note); the read/write path is shared by both readouts so it cannot bias the between-readout contrast this run routes on. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 seeds x 4 arms x 5 sequences): no crash; status PASS; non_degenerate True; notably the hybrid and e1-alone readouts produced BIT-IDENTICAL cr_ratio(h=1) on every cell (e.g. seed42/ARM_rc_flat: 6.624974e-04 both), confirming the docstring's coincide-at-h=1 claim numerically before any full run. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks. validate_recording.py --strict: complete, 0 always-core gaps. red-team (fable): CONTESTED, 2 findings, both fixed before queueing. F-A (verdict-grid composition): the run-level label logic was missing an 'and none show the opposite' conjunct (already required by the docstring) -- a contradictory arm pair (one consumer-suppresses, one hybrid-suppresses) would have emitted the discriminating consumer-suppresses headline instead of readout_regime_mixed_across_arms; fixed with explicit exclusion conjuncts. F-B (self-certifying gate): the two h=1-only finiteness preconditions did not cover the DECISION horizons (h=5, h=30) the damping verdict actually reads, so a NaN cell there could pass every readiness gate while silently starving _damping_verdict's sample size -- at the limit manufacturing a confident 'not_damped' (and hence the discriminating headline) from zero evidence; fixed with a new precondition (cr_ratio_finite_at_decision_horizons) gating the same horizons/readouts the verdict reads, plus a defense-in-depth n_total floor that verdicts 'undetermined' rather than a false 'not_damped'. Families 1 (manipulation->DV) and 2 (criterion construction) cleared with no finding. Machine affinity: any, prefer cloud (per the autopsy's ~11 min cloud-worker estimate for the retrain; this driver's added Phase-4 readout is cheaper than the hybrid's per-step loop, one predict_long_horizon call per sequence, so runtime should stay close to 976's own).

items.title: MECH-320 diagnostic: is v_t's floor-saturation (v_t_floor=0.05) gate-caused or v_raw-caused? (calmed P2 bed, seeds 42/43/45)
items.note: diagnostic (not evidence): characterizes WHY v_t sits at v_t_floor=0.05 in V3-EXQ-951's regime -- gate suppression vs low v_raw -- via a per-tick joint classification on already-exposed TonicVigor.get_state() (no ree_core change). Calmed P2 bed (scaffold_p2_num_hazards=0, scaffold_p2_proximity_harm_scale=0.0, scaffold_p2_hazard_food_attraction_guard=0.0) + seeds [42,43,45], per chip-20260901-mech320-noop-margin-dv-substrate's design (reproduced independently here; does not depend on that chip's own driver landing). GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): checked v3_exq_951_mech320_tonic_vigor_authority_sd054_20260830T125526Z_v3.json (uncalmed bed, seeds 42/43/44) -- seed 44's arms show v_t_mean=0.0500 with gate_product_mean=1.0000 (suggestive but not a per-tick joint test), while seeds 42/43 don't hit the floor at all (v_t_mean 1.3-2.6); that manifest records no per-tick series and is on the wrong bed/seed-set for this chip's question -- not recoverable, ran fresh. red-team (fable): CONTESTED, 4 findings (F1-F4), ALL FIXED prior to queueing, none waived. F1 -- a probe wrapping agent.select_action re-reads the SAME latched TonicVigor state on every non-E3 tick (agent.py:7138's short-circuit returns before compute_score_bias/update_score_receipt run at all), pseudo-replicating one real observation into many and silently inflating n_floor_hit past the sufficiency gate. F2 -- reading state post-select_action pairs v_raw (already advanced by update_score_receipt) against the PRIOR tick's last_v_t, a one-tick skew. Both fixed by wrapping tv.compute_score_bias directly instead: fires exactly once per genuine vigor computation, and reads state before update_score_receipt runs later in the same select_action call. F3 -- a pooled gate_caused_frac can mask cross-seed/cross-arm heterogeneity (one always-floored raw_caused seed swamping a rarely-floored gate_caused seed); now surfaced via heterogeneous_across_cells + a '_heterogeneous_across_cells' label suffix when any individual cell disagrees with the pooled classification. F4 -- P1 wasn't checked for .aborted like every earlier training phase, and the pool included seeds that failed the P1 survival gate (moribund-seed gate suppression leaking into a pool presented as survivors-only); fixed with a p1.aborted check routing to _fail, and _pool_p2_floor_stats now excludes unsurvived seeds (n_seeds_excluded_unsurvived reported). Re-smoke-tested post-fix (1 seed, --dry-run): rc=0, label=vt_floor_driven_by_low_v_raw, sufficient_floor_hit_sample met, heterogeneous=False. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings across all checks. Spawned by chip-20260901-mech320-vt-floor-diagnostic; complementary/non-blocking to the DV-redesign chip-20260901-mech320-noop-margin-dv-substrate (V3-EXQ-951b) -- either can land first. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): fires on MECH-320 (5 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsies) but is EXEMPT here -- this is a diagnostic whose purpose is to discriminate WHY the v_t-floor ceiling holds (gate suppression vs low v_raw), not a same-granularity lettered evidence re-test of MECH-320's selection-authority claim (that is V3-EXQ-951/951a/951b's job, not this script's -- see EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE="diagnostic" and evidence_direction="non_contributory" by construction).
